sources.surface_method: ODOL56 visual horizontal face support with 12cm footprint; bounded decoded visual/collision proxy tables, composite interior and exposed cabinet tiers; proxy marker faces excluded; raw building frame, restored furniture centres; 0.10m candidate lattice and measured prop centres snapped to mesh tops; 5mm lift; Z-edge-first plane ordering with .60m separation; collision and reach audits before spacing/cap including full optional-prop item/body volumes, swept corridor and eye obstruction; optional props never support; final collision-only support/enclosure gate (see collision_support)
sources.floor_method: ODOL geometry+roadway floors on a 0.5 m grid; 12 cm footprint support; door leaves opened (removed from the walk scene); visual or collision/proxy roof 1.9-8.0 m above; 3 of 8 rays at 1 m hit structure within 5 m; loot_reach_audit body_clear and 50 cm loader box; 4-neighbour walk (|dy|<=0.3 m, approach_clear corridor) from door/ladder memory sills within 2 m; 1.0 m door clearance; farthest-point spread 1.5 m, one per 8 m2 of connected floor
